moments.text: Steady IR view across hazy water to a low bright shoreline, two tall thin structures right of the crosshair, a small dark shape above it.
A small white dash with a faint trail enters at the upper left edge, crosses left to right, sinking slightly, exits right after 3.4 s.
The view stays fixed on the shoreline with nothing moving until the clip ends.

notes: Official text says 14 s; the file is 11.7 s, but the transit times match.
